caption: The drawing contains nine diamond-shaped textile patterns arranged in three horizontal rows and three vertical columns, spaced evenly on a plain, light beige background. Each diamond features a unique pattern and color scheme. The top row has three diamonds: the left one is primarily brown with orange, black, and white geometric lines; the center one is orange and beige with cross motifs; the right one is mainly black and red with horizontal stripes and small motifs. In the middle row, the left diamond is off-white with pink and black diagonal motifs, the center is solid pink with circular designs, and the right side diamond is white with diagonal pink, black, and green bands. The bottom row has a left diamond that is brown with floral motifs, a center diamond with horizontal red, white, and black bands (partially obscured by a vertical stain), and a right diamond with multi-colored horizontal bands and small patterns. The name "ELEANOR GAUSSER" appears faintly in the bottom right corner of the page.
title: Patches from Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
